name: Should I insulate and drywall my garage or leave the studs exposed?

mainEntity.name: Should I insulate and drywall my garage or leave the studs exposed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Insulating and drywalling garage walls makes a significant difference if you plan to use the space year-round in the Denver metro area, where seasonal temperatures fluctuate dramatically. Adding insulation helps regulate indoor garage temperatures, protects stored items, and keeps attached living spaces warmer in winter. Drywall also provides an airtight barrier, reduces drafts, and delivers a clean, finished foundation for mounting cabinets or painting. If the garage serves strictly for parking vehicles and unconditioned storage, leaving open studs remains a practical, lower-cost alternative.
acceptedAnswer.description: Insulating and drywalling creates a comfortable, climate-resilient space for workshops and protects adjacent living areas, while exposed studs save on upfront costs for basic parking.
